title: Referral Bonus Awarding Flow
purpose: Full referral lifecycle from code generation through signup validation, bonus awarding, milestone checks, highlighting the missing payout mechanism, unprotected routes, and PII exposure
description: Four-stage referral system: (1) Code Generation — referral.model.ts generates two codes per user: {USERNAME}-CASH (fixed $50 bonus per referred spender) and {USERNAME}-PERCENT (1% of referred user's spending). uses_count column tracks redemptions. (2) Signup Validation — new user submits referral code during signup, auth.service.ts validates code exists and is active via referral.model.ts:trackReferralUse which increments uses_count. (3) Bonus Awarding (async) — when referred user makes a payment, awardReferralBonus calculates cash (fixedAmount) or percent (paymentAmount * percentRate / 100) bonus. (4) Milestone Check — checks if referrer reached $750 total earnings, 30-day window since first referral, and $25 speed bonus if first referral within 7 days. Critical gaps: no actual payout mechanism (bonuses calculated and logged but never disbursed), 2 unprotected referral routes (missing protect middleware), and PII in codes (username embedded directly in referral code string).

validationRules.rule: One code set per user (rejects if codes already exist)
Code must be uppercased for lookup
Referral must have is_active = true to be usable

businessRules.rule: CASH type: fixed $50 bonus per referred spender
PERCENT type: 1% of referred user's spending
Speed bonus: $25 if first referral within 7 days (14 days = $50 base, 15-30 days = $50 base only)
No actual payout mechanism — bonuses tracked in DB only, never disbursed

securityConsiderations: 2 unprotected routes: /check-milestone/:userId and /validate/:code have no auth middleware — internal endpoints exposed
PII exposure: Username embedded directly in referral code string — anyone seeing code knows referrer's username
No rate limiting on public validation endpoint — potential for enumeration attacks
Milestone bonus has no actual payout — internal ledger only, but tracked as debt
RLS enforced at DB level but unprotected routes could leak user earnings data
performanceConsiderations: Referral operations are lightweight DB queries
Bonus awarding is async (triggered by payment) — does not block request path
Milestone check queries past transactions — could be slow for high-volume creators

annotations.text: No actual payout mechanism — referral bonuses are calculated and logged in DB but never disbursed to referrer's wallet or bank account
2 unprotected referral routes (/check-milestone/:userId and /validate/:code) — missing protect middleware, exposing internal endpoints
PII exposure: referral code format is {USERNAME}-CASH or {USERNAME}-PERCENT — username embedded directly in the code string
Four-stage lifecycle: Code Generation → Signup Validation → Bonus Awarding → Milestone Check
